confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and comparable-city calibration; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation anchors are least certain because July peak-season rates vary widely, and local tourist tax and booking fees are not separately modelled. Beer assumes a 0.5 L draught to match the comparable-city basis. Cocktail and wine_glass are derived from the beer anchor using approximate local price relationships (cocktail roughly twice the beer; wine glass slightly above it), not from direct price checks.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated against Rome, London and Madrid. Amsterdam cafe and restaurant anchors fall between the Madrid/Rome level and the London level. Hostel and hotel anchors sit above all three to reflect higher Amsterdam July accommodation demand and limited budget supply.
